models.name: HackathonConfig
models.field_constraint_contract: event OneToOne; enabled; version; review_mode `auto/rolling/batch`; application open/close; team_mode `solo/individual_then_team/team_together`; finder_enabled; team_min/max; team_lock_at; review_count default 2; blind_review; review_rubric JSON version; RSVP days default 4; offer_capacity (null means Event.capacity; explicit integer may overbook offers); submission open/deadline/grace; late policy `reject/accept_flagged`; attendance_required default true for onsite, false online; upload_policy name/version; storage_budget_bytes nullable unlimited only self-host; gallery/results pointers; CoC version + private immutable text revision; optional MLH schema; first_results_published_at; retention_anchor_at. Event.capacity remains the sole hard RSVP ceiling, ticket capacity its additional constraint. Validate all windows, positive sizes, team_min≤max and server ceilings.

models.name: HackathonApplication
models.field_constraint_contract: event, member, registration nullable OneToOne until submission; cohort nullable; state; version; encrypted answers/profile snapshot; form/schema version; CoC revision and accepted_at; optional sharing-consent purposes/version/timestamps; submitted_at; offered_at; RSVP_due_at; response_at; queue_position_at; decision_revision; immutable notified-decision reference. Unique(event,member), including terminal rows: reapply revises the same record under policy, never creates duplicate identity.

models.name: HackathonApplicationCohort
models.field_constraint_contract: event, team OneToOne, state/version, sealed_roster_hash; only team-together mode. Every member owns their application/consent. Cohort commands release a decision atomically to the sealed roster.

models.name: ApplicationReviewAssignment
models.field_constraint_contract: nullable application/cohort FKs with exactly-one CHECK, reviewer member, round; unique(subject,reviewer,round); assigned/submitted/recused; rubric revision, criterion scores 1–5, encrypted notes, submitted_at. Self/team/declared conflict exclusions. N distinct reviewers required before reviewed release unless an audited override is stored. `hackathons/review_workflow.py` owns review assignment/submit/recuse; admission_workflow alone releases decisions.

models.name: ApplicationReview
models.field_constraint_contract: nullable application/cohort FKs with exactly-one CHECK, reviewer member, round; unique(subject,reviewer,round); assigned/submitted/recused; rubric revision, criterion scores 1–5, encrypted notes, submitted_at. Self/team/declared conflict exclusions. N distinct reviewers required before reviewed release unless an audited override is stored. `hackathons/review_workflow.py` owns review assignment/submit/recuse; admission_workflow alone releases decisions.

models.name: ApplicationDecisionBatch
models.field_constraint_contract: event, actor, state `draft/committed/cancelled`, version; subject, proposed outcome `offer/waitlist/reject`, reason code, expected subject version, sent_revision. Only one active draft decision per subject. Sent decisions append immutable history; later changes require a new explicit correction.

models.name: ApplicationDecision
models.field_constraint_contract: event, actor, state `draft/committed/cancelled`, version; subject, proposed outcome `offer/waitlist/reject`, reason code, expected subject version, sent_revision. Only one active draft decision per subject. Sent decisions append immutable history; later changes require a new explicit correction.

models.name: HackathonTeam
models.field_constraint_contract: event, UUID public_id, name, leader FK member, state `forming/locked/disbanded`, version, structured zone/table, seeking_members, public finder text/skills, public_profile_refs; unique(event, normalized active name) with collision-safe suffix suggestions.

models.name: HackathonTeamMember
models.field_constraint_contract: event, team, application/member, state `invited/requested/active/left/removed`, joined_at/left_at, creator. Partial unique(event,member) for active memberships; same-event/leader membership checks. Pending invites do not reserve team slots.

models.name: HackathonTeamInvite
models.field_constraint_contract: team, digest token, optional verified-email digest, expiry/revoked/redeemed timestamps. No raw token in lists/outboxes/export. Share via fragment, rotate/revoke, never by public attendee contact list.

models.name: EventRoleAssignment
models.field_constraint_contract: event, member, posting nullable, origin `self/invited/staff`, role `co_organizer/volunteer/mentor/judge/sponsor_rep`, sponsor nullable, state `draft/proposed/applied/approved/declined/withdrawn/revoked/completed`, approved_by/at, consent revision, encrypted application notes/answers, form_schema_version, answer_locked_at, date_review_required, display_on_page false, explicit selected presentation reference (§9A), skills tags, availability, version. Partial unique(event,member,role,sponsor) while active, including correct null-sponsor uniqueness. A self application uses draft→applied and owns its own EventAnswerDerivation subjects (§10A). Contribution history survives grant revocation.

models.name: EventGrantEntitlement

models.name: EventRolePosting
models.field_constraint_contract: event (series defaults copied per occurrence), role volunteer/mentor, title/description/briefing, skills, visibility public/members/audience_organizations, approval_required, open/close, waiver/training requirements, allowed permission preset, version, status draft/open/closed. No age requirement.

models.name: EventShift
models.field_constraint_contract: posting, event, starts/ends, zone/task, capacity (0 unlimited), signup deadline, waitlist_enabled, approval_required, minimum briefing/training references, permission window; validates event window and bounded grace.

models.name: EventShiftSignup

models.name: EventContributionHours
